Apply to the Trade Committee of UAAC, request supplies collector to trade with your colony. If the application is responded, the supplies collector closest to your colony will arrive at your colony in a few hours.
LanguageData.SEC_Permit_Apply_for_Travelling_Secretar: Apply to the local Secretary Nexus, request secretaries to assist in the development of the colony. Under normal conditions, two outworker secretaries will response to application, they will stay in your colony for 15 days, as long as they are still in your colony, you need to ensure their safety.
LanguageData.SEC_Permit_Apply_for_Trader_Secretary.de: Apply to the local Secretary Nexus, request supplies collector to trade with your colony. If the application is responded, the supplies collector closest to your colony will arrive at your colony in a few hours.
Apply to the local Secretary Nexus, request resident secretary to be stationed in your colony. Resident secretary is not like outworker secretary, resident secretaries are clones designed to serve the Alfaus' colonies with various specialties. They will reside in your colony for a long time and provide services. Please note, your colony is not the only place that needs secretaries, you need to wait for one or two years before the local secretary nexus can allow you to have the next resident secretary.
LanguageData.SEC_Permit_Apply_for_HMG_AI_Turret_Suppo: Apply for Automatic HMG Turret Support
Apply to the local Secretary Nexus, request the orbital support system to deploy a turret pod to the location you marked.
LanguageData.SEC_Permit_Apply_for_Shield_Generator_Su: Apply to the local Secretary Nexus, request the orbital support system to deploy a disposable shield generator pod to the location you marked.
LanguageData.SEC_Permit_Apply_for_Disposable_RPG_Supp: Apply to the local Secretary Nexus, request the orbital support system to deploy a pod containing two disposable rocket-propelled grenade launchers to the location you marked.
LanguageData.SEC_Permit_Apply_for_Orbital_Autocannon_: Apply to the local Secretary Nexus, request the orbital support system to fire the autocannon towards the target position.
LanguageData.SEC_Permit_Apply_for_Orbital_Cannon_HE_S: Apply to the local Secretary Nexus, request the orbital support system to fire 122mm high-explosive cannon shells towards the target position.
LanguageData.SEC_Permit_Apply_for_Orbital_500kg_HE_St: Apply for Orbital 500kg HE Bomb Strike
Apply to the local Secretary Nexus, request the orbital support system to launch a 500kg high-explosive bomb by standard mass driver to the target position.
LanguageData.SEC_Permit_Apply_for_Orbital_500kg_EMP_S: Apply for Orbital EMP Bomb Strike
Apply to the local Secretary Nexus, request the orbital support system to launch an EMP bomb by standard mass driver to the target position.
